messages:
laura: Hey team — urgent heads-up, gotta step out for a family emergency in ~30m. I'm the primary for the EU-night slot tonight and won't be reachable overnight. Can someone pick up primary or do a quick handoff? No active incidents right now but we do have a low-volume regression test job queued. @mike @devon @jess :wave:

mike: I can take the first 4 hours (local timezone conflict afterwards). Happy to be primary until ~02:30 UTC.

devon: I can take the full overnight if needed. No meetings.

jess: I can be secondary/backup to whichever of you becomes primary. Will stay reachable.

laura: Thank you. Quick checklist for whoever takes primary:
- monitor /services/inference-api in obs (per-route latency > 150ms alert)
- watch paging channel and escalation rules (15m -> secondary -> oncall-sre)
- run the smoke-runbook if any 5xx trend shows up: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-smoke
- prefix cache bump command if you need to flush: `kubectl -n inference exec deploy/router -- /app/bin/cachectl flush-prefix "eu-"`

laura: There are two points to note: the queued regression job hits a few models with long sequence lengths (up to 4k) and can spike memory usage. If you see memory climb, scale the pool with:`kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/inference-gpu-pool -n infra`

sre-bot: No active incidents. Next scheduled maintenance: model-quantization job at 03:00 UTC (non-blocking).

mike: Quick Q — what are the paging rules exact wording? Is it 15m to secondary or do we escalate earlier for p95 latency breaches?

laura: Policy is in the runbook: p95 latency > 500ms for 10m triggers a SEV2, page primary immediately. For sustained errors (5xx > 2% over 5m) page primary and notify secondary at 15m. If primary doesn't ack within 5m, paging repeats.

devon: I'll take full primary. @jess you good as secondary?

jess: Yep, I'm set. I'll monitor paging and take over if devon needs to escalate.

laura: Amazing, thank you devon and jess. Handing off state:
- No ongoing incidents.
- Active regression job queued id=reg-2026-11 (watch model 3-bert-long).
- Costly path: batch size autotune turned on for eu region.
- Known flaky route: /v1/reembed (rate limit throttle sometimes shows 429s).

devon: Got it. I will set my presence to "Primary - EU night" and pin the runbook in channel. Also setting a short alert to email if sevs escalate.

devon: quick command to verify queue depth: `curl -s "http://metrics.internal/services/inference-api/queue" | jq '.pending'`

mike: Dev, if you need me to swap in later just ping here. I can be a warm backup from 02:30 UTC onwards.

incident-bot: Pager test log: most recent page for inference-api cleared at 1768909800. No open pages.

jess: I'll watch the 15m window for escalations and will follow the runbook escalation steps. If anything looks like memory spike, I'll scale and post the k8s events.

devon: I'm going to set a temporary routing policy to prefer smaller sequence models for low-latency endpoints until the regression job finishes: `redwoodctl route update inference-api --favor-small-seq=1h` (will revert after reg job).

laura: Thanks again. Leaving now — handoff done if devon confirms. Please ping me only for critical SEV1s I might be able to respond to.

devon: I confirm — I am primary. jess is secondary. I pinned the runbook and set presence. All notes noted.

jess: ACK. I'll post updates every hour or immediately on paging.

mike: Thanks team. Safe emergency exit laura.

laura: Appreciate it, will follow up tomorrow. :heart:

devon: Closing the handoff thread — devon primary / jess secondary. Leaving a brief sticky in the runbook: "1768912345 handoff — laura out, devon primary, jess secondary."

jess: Received. Monitoring started.
